title: Federal Register Modernization Act of 2024
official_summary:
Federal Register Modernization Act of 2024

This act revises provisions regarding the Federal Register and the Code of Federal Regulations, including to replace requirements that the documents be printed with requirements that the documents be published.

The act also

  • eliminates the requirement for federal agencies to provide duplicate originals or certified copies of agency documents submitted for publication in the Federal Register;

  • specifies that a designee of the President may fulfill certain functions, such as approving regulations related to the publication of the Federal Register prescribed by the Administrative Committee of the Federal Register; and

  • provides that in a continuity of operations event in which the Government Publishing Office (GPO) does not fulfill its publication requirements, the Office of the Federal Register may establish an alternative method to publish the Federal Register until such time that GPO resumes publication.

summary.headline: Law updates rules for the Federal Register so it can be published, including digitally, instead of required to be printed.
summary.what_it_does: The law changes rules for the Federal Register and the Code of Federal Regulations, the official records of federal rules and notices. It replaces requirements that they be printed with requirements that they be published. Agencies no longer must send duplicate originals or certified copies of documents they submit, and someone the President picks can approve certain publishing rules. If the Government Publishing Office cannot publish during an emergency, the Office of the Federal Register may use another method until it resumes.

who_it_affects.how: They no longer have to send duplicate originals or certified copies of documents submitted for publication in the Federal Register.
It may set up a backup way to publish the Federal Register if the Government Publishing Office cannot do so during an emergency.
Its duties shift from printing the Federal Register and Code of Federal Regulations to publishing them.

who_it_affects.group: People and businesses who follow federal rules
who_it_affects.how: The official records of federal rules they rely on may be published in formats other than print.

summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on January 4, 2025; the summary does not give a separate start date.
